thread:
maria-llm: Nightly flagged a big drop on cs_summaries_v2 after promoting v14a. Can we triage? :eyes:

ci-bot: nightly-eval: candidate=v14a baseline=v13c. pass_rate=59% (baseline 86%). Top regressions: JSON_schema 90->44, csv-sep 96->58, list-separators 93->50. Report: https://internal.eval/reports/1758881234

dan-ml: Pasted failing sample below. Reference, then v13c (good), then v14a (bad).

Reference:
```json
{"summary": {"errors": ["card declined","address mismatch"], "priority": "urgent"}}
```

v13c (good):
```json
{"summary": {"errors": ["card declined", "address mismatch"], "priority": "urgent"}}
```

v14a (bad):
```json
{"summary": {"errors": ["card declined" "address mismatch"], "priority": "urgent"}}
```

dan-ml: Notice missing commas between list items and sometimes commas replaced by spaces in short enumerations — breaks our JSON ingest.

ryan-infra: Was there a tokenizer change in v14a? I recall a micro-merge to compress newline-prefixed whitespace tokens (PR #4312) rolled with the bring-up.

dan-ml: Yes, v14a combined that tokenizer patch with new weights from run-05. Both landed in the same promotion.

ryan-infra: Can we reproduce deterministically? Run with temp=0, seed=123 and dump tokenization for baseline vs candidate.

elaine-qa: I'm on it. Running local reproducer now. Will paste token-level diff.

elaine-qa: Tokenization diff (deterministic run):
```text
prompt: "1) card declined
2) address mismatch"
v13c tokens: ["1", ")", "▁card", "▁declined", "\n", "2", ")", "▁address", "▁mismatch"]
v14a tokens: ["1", ")", "▁card", "▁declined
2", ")", "▁address", "▁mismatch"]
```

elaine-qa: v14a merged the trailing newline into the previous token ("declined
2"), which shifts where the model places separators/punctuation when decoding. That explains missing commas/spaces.

dan-ml: That matches the failing examples. Even when the model intends to emit a comma, token alignment causes the decoder to prefer a space or drop the comma.

ryan-infra: Immediate proposal: (1) build candidate with tokenizer revert and re-run targeted nightly; (2) run v14a weights with v13c tokenizer to isolate weight impact; (3) run int8 vs fp16 comparator to check quantization interactions. I can handle (1) and (3) today.

maria-llm: I ran v14a weights + v13c tokenizer locally (deterministic). Pass_rate for cs_summaries_v2 went to 82% (baseline 86). So tokenizer change is the main culprit.

ci-bot: action logged: triage assigned to ryan-infra, dan-ml, elaine-qa. Re-run scheduled (priority=high).

ryan-infra: We'll block the tokenizer merge from next promotion until we validate. Will prepare a rollback candidate and run the targeted eval (beam=1 temp=0 top_p=1).

dan-ml: I'll collect more failing samples (CSV-like lists, JSON arrays, bullet lists) to include in the RCA and add tokenization diffs to the nightly report.

elaine-qa: Note: some prompts show commas preserved but spacing collapsed ("apple, banana" -> "apple banana"). This affects CSV and quick entity extraction heuristics.

maria-llm: Thanks. I'll draft an RCA with sample diffs and recommend: revert tokenizer merge, add tokenization-diff check to pre-promote evals, and mark tokenizer merges as eval-P1 in the PR template.

ryan-infra: Uploading artifacts and logs: https://internal.ci/artifacts/1758881234/diffs.tar.gz

ci-bot: triaged -> in_progress. Will post updated nightly results after rerun.
